simple.meaning: עֲנָוָה (ʻănâvâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “condescension , human and subjective (modesty), or divine and objective (clemency).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֲנָוָה (H6038) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 15:33, with occurrences in Proverbs, Zephaniah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲנָוָה (H6038) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עֲנָוָה (H6038) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עֲנָוָה (ʻănâvâh) / H6038 is traced through Proverbs 15:33, Proverbs 18:12, Proverbs 22:4, Zephaniah 2:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom.
Before destruction the heart of man is proud,
